label: English

splash.title: You don't have to go through this alone
splash.subtitle: Maahyu is a quiet place to talk about how you feel. No forms, no typing — just your voice.

home.sub: Tap and talk, like a voice note to a friend
home.processing: Maahyu is listening to what you shared…

escalation.title: You matter, and you don't have to carry this alone.
escalation.body: It sounds like things have been really hard. Would you like to talk to a real person right now?

connect.title: Reaching out
connect.body: Connecting you with your local ASHA worker / helpline.

calendar.title: Your calendar
calendar.sub: One dot for every day you talked to Maahyu. Tap a day to listen back.
calendar.empty: Nothing here yet — your first voice note will show up as a dot.

settings.title: Settings
settings.voiceSub: Maahyu speaks its replies out loud
settings.shareSub: Off by default. Nothing is ever shared automatically.
settings.signOutNote: Your voice notes are private to you and never shown to anyone else unless you choose to share.

offline: You're offline — Maahyu still works. Your voice note will send once you're back online.
